payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_record_migrate.py::test_the_top_up_sets_aside_only_its_named_differences stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/record/migrate.py. The claim was "The top-up sets aside exactly these differences between a held fact and the ledger's. Its `at`. On a `gate_result`, `schema_version`, `collected` and `uncollected`. A null `batch_key`. Anything in `task_created`. Any fact of a kind `migrate` never writes, which the witness drives for every member of `KINDS` outside the sixteen. Each alone, on a ref that otherwise holds every fact the ledger owes, leaves the task migrated with nothing appended. A differing `summary` on a `gate_result`, a `schema_version` key on an `attempt_closed`, and a set `batch_key` that differs on an `attempt_closed` each refuse the ref.", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
